annotations.title: Confirm a prepared payment on chain

description: After your wallet has sent a payment prepared by prepare_payment, give its prepare_id and transaction hash. SwapEazi reads the receipt on chain, verifies it came from the prepared wallet and matches the prepared transaction, and returns a signed payment record for the audit trail. Read-only on chain; moves nothing.

contribute.description: True adds one anonymised row (token, network, month, size band) to SwapEazi's cost research.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash your wallet broadcast: 0x plus 64 hex characters on EVM chains, 64 hex characters on Tron.
